architecture_options.cost_and_data: Highest immediate GPU/data cost; requires a larger robot-specific or controlled simulation dataset and careful timing lock.
architecture_options.falsifier_or_strengthener: Healthy held-out profiles and overlap under the same dense ABI strengthen the current architecture; persistent oscillation after controlled scale weakens dense H40.
architecture_options.scientific_upside: Directly tests whether the dense H40 EEF hypothesis becomes healthy under official-scale custom-embodiment training and matching runtime semantics.

architecture_options.cost_and_data: Moderate implementation/runtime cost; requires explicit timing, chunk-age, and inter-chunk accounting, and can mask full-chunk quality if not audited.
architecture_options.falsifier_or_strengthener: Healthy raw chunks plus stable receding execution strengthen a runtime explanation; raw intra-chunk oscillation remains unchanged and falsifies a runtime-only explanation.
architecture_options.scientific_upside: Separates prediction horizon/profile burden from execution latency by using shorter state-relative chunks, async scheduling, and RTC where valid.

architecture_options.cost_and_data: Requires a new waypoint/target-time ABI, interpolation contract, and matched evaluation; increases interface design burden and may reduce endpoint expressivity.
architecture_options.falsifier_or_strengthener: Stable waypoints plus transparent interpolation with improved task-space outcomes strengthen it; failure before interpolation or dependence on hidden correction weakens it.
architecture_options.scientific_upside: Tests whether the VLA is better suited to sparse task-space intent while an explicit, declared interpolation/rate-limit layer owns smoothness before WBC.

architecture_options.cost_and_data: Largest research cost: trajectory corpus, tokenizer/decoder training, representation validation, and a new checkpoint/ABI lifecycle.
architecture_options.falsifier_or_strengthener: A frozen token decoder reconstructing WBC-compatible smooth references and improving held-out profile/overlap metrics strengthens it; no reconstruction gain or embodiment leakage weakens it.
architecture_options.scientific_upside: Moves temporal smoothness into a learned compact task-space manifold, inspired by SONIC without requiring the Go2+ARX5 VLA to emit low-level whole-body channels.

attribution_matrix.boundary: No new model run was performed; source review cannot close the prior run's input provenance.
Existing sealed Phase B evidence reports H200 resource/OOM ruled out; this review did not rerun it.
O1 has only 200 steps and each max-step run has its own warmup/decay schedule.
Free-running profile failure does not prove teacher-forced objective failure.
Tiny-stat degeneracy is retained as a diagnostic warning, not a demonstrated cause of H2.
High path/tortuosity/frequency metrics support the phenotype, not one unique mechanism.
Analytic inactive/active noise energy ratio 12.2x is not causal proof.
Sampler is a candidate factor; no C1 or sampler comparison was authorized.
Official custom guidance uses substantially more presentations and multiple demonstration windows.
Stage23 differs from official defaults in dropout, color jitter, VLLN, batch, H, and custom-slot exposure; none is proven causal here.
